data.title: Commerce that belongs in EmDash.
data.description: Open-source commerce tools for your EmDash site, with hosted services being built to make setup simpler.

layout.heading: An EmDash foundation
layout.body: Keep your storefront and content in EmDash. DinkusKit is building the catalog, checkout, inventory and payments connections around it.

layout.heading: Inventory, connected
layout.body: The planned Registry installation connects your site to DinkusKit-hosted Inventory. You manage stock in EmDash without configuring Cloudflare yourself.

layout.heading: Your Stripe account
layout.body: The planned Payments plugin connects your own Stripe account through hosted setup. Customers pay your business through Stripe.

layout.heading: Follow the build
layout.body: Hosted accounts and service activation are not available on this website yet. Explore the source on GitHub and read Getting started for the intended installation experience.

data.title: Your site. One connected experience.
data.description: The first DinkusKit experience is for people who already have an EmDash site.

layout.heading: 1. Install from the Registry
layout.body: The intended release installs DinkusKit plugins through the EmDash Registry. These integrations are still in development; this site is not an installation or activation service yet.

layout.heading: 2. Connect your DinkusKit account
layout.body: The planned flow lets you sign in, authorize your site, and connect services. The same account will be able to connect multiple stores.

layout.heading: 3. Set up inventory and payments
layout.body: Name your first stock location or reconnect existing inventory, and complete Stripe setup for your business. Everyday store administration stays in EmDash.

layout.heading: Trial access
layout.body: Initial hosted Inventory access is planned as a trial without payment details. Trial duration, usage limits and pricing have not been set.
